scope: Internal TrailONE 505 native Android GPX utility; single primary device; no public release intent

owner_approval.decision: Use the current installed application release as the baseline for future development
owner_approval.evidence: Explicit approval in BRAND project conversation following owner confirmation of successful installation, expected behavior and compliant GPX output

accepted_behavior.source_handling: Preserve original GPX and output a separate enriched GPX document
accepted_behavior.processing: Existing accepted GPX enrichment, waypoint generation and statistics

source_reference.relationship_to_installed_binary: Delivered candidate associated with accepted workflow; exact binary-to-source provenance not independently verified

release_governance.freeze_scope: Accepted functional behavior and on-device operation
release_governance.changes_require: Explicit approved scope, version increment, regression tests and rollback plan
release_governance.approval_does_not_prove: Cryptographic signing, binary reproducibility or exhaustive device testing
